title: Meta says Wonder includes Active Memory and Active Focus, two features designed to help AI systems perform more useful work over extended periods (Ina Fried/Axios)
summary: Ina Fried / Axios: Meta says Wonder includes Active Memory and Active Focus, two features designed to help AI systems perform more useful work over extended periods — Meta on Monday launched a new family of AI models that it says can compete at the technological frontier, marking a major milestone …
